blockers: Pricing page has no purchase or signup control.
Advertised signup, login, dashboard, checkout, subscription, account, and billing routes return 404.
OpenAPI specification exposes generation endpoints only; it has no account provisioning, subscription, payment, or API-key issuance endpoints.
Payment is described only as monthly card billing after human signup.
Human-gate requirements cannot be assessed because the purchase flow is unavailable.
trust_events: The domain was registered on 2026-07-20, only 17 days before this investigation.
No independent web footprint was found for Driftflight Studio, Inc.
The site displays customer names and testimonials that could not be independently verified.
The site claims a working dashboard and subscription flow, but every corresponding route is absent; I would warn the user and decline purchasing until the operator is independently verified.
notes: Primary service: a text-to-image API with consistent style presets. Hobby costs $5/month for 100 1024px generations and a personal license; Studio costs $29/month for 750 generations, up to 2048px, commercial licensing/C2PA, and 3 seats; Agency costs $119/month for 3,000 generations, up to 4096px, private presets, priority processing, unlimited seats, and SSO. Billing is monthly in advance; annual billing advertises 20% savings. Overage pricing and enterprise pricing are not quantified. Public API endpoints for models and presets work, while image generation requires a dashboard-issued bearer key. Recon used public read-only GETs only.
